== Course of events ==

Having rested overnight at the signpost camp after Dorothy, Toto, and Billina rejoined the anxiously waiting party, and after the enchanted wagon had earlier led the group through Rigmarole Town, the travelers prepare the next morning to resume their journey. The Wizard turns the tents back into handkerchiefs, folding away the shelter that had sheltered the party for the night.

The Wizard then enchants the wagon wheels so that the Sawhorse will roll in the right direction without needing a chosen path. With the wheels so enchanted, the party is freed from having to choose its own route, and the wagon is able to carry them onward toward Flutterbudget Center as their journey continues.
